description.fr-FR: Les lettres de sainte Jeanne-Françoise de Chantal, tome I de la correspondance de l’édition Plon (lettres 1 à 361), rangées par ordre chronologique : à saint François de Sales, aux premières Mères de la Visitation, aux Sœurs, à des évêques, des princes et des personnes du monde. Avec les notes et les sommaires des éditeurs.
description.en-US: The letters of St. Jane Frances de Chantal, volume I of the correspondence in the Plon edition (letters 1 to 361), in chronological order: to St. Francis de Sales, the first Mothers of the Visitation, the Sisters, bishops, princes and people in the world. With the editors’ notes and summaries.
description.pt-BR: As cartas de santa Joana Francisca de Chantal, tomo I da correspondência da edição Plon (cartas 1 a 361), em ordem cronológica: a são Francisco de Sales, às primeiras Madres da Visitação, às Irmãs, a bispos, príncipes e pessoas do mundo. Com as notas e os sumários dos editores.

fr-FR.editor: Religieuses du Premier Monastère de la Visitation d’Annecy

sources.edition: Sainte Jeanne-Françoise Frémyot de Chantal, sa vie et ses œuvres, Plon, Paris, 1874–1879 (Édition authentique publiée par les soins des Religieuses du Premier Monastère de la Visitation Sainte-Marie d’Annecy), tome 4: Lettres, tome I. Scan of the Bibliothèque Sainte-Geneviève copy; text from the archive.org OCR.
sources.description: OCR text cleaned: running heads and page numbers removed, hyphenation joined, page-bottom notes turned into footnotes. The addressee and the editors’ summary head each letter (the summary in italics). Spelling is that of the 1870s edition. Letters whose number heading the OCR lost are folded into the previous letter, so a few numbers are missing. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Saint Jane de Chantal died in 1641; Plon edition 1877–79; the letters are public domain.
